title: Batching

validation.research: Four official primary references: Microsoft Azure SQL establishes the general fixed-overhead and bounded-buffer technique; Google Pub/Sub exposes count/byte/latency batching settings; Microsoft Graph documents independent member identity/status and response ordering; AWS DynamoDB BatchWriteItem documents per-item versus whole-batch atomicity and selective unprocessed-item retries. Batching is the established general name, with no invented aliases. Existing data-microbatch-processing and ml-batch-serving are preserved specialized architectures, not duplicates of a generic collector. Performance and Scalability is the sole primary home because shared overhead is the central mechanism. Formation versus transport/business completion, pending versus outstanding ownership, age progress, serialized size, authorization compatibility, ordering, partial success and uncertain outcomes are explicit. The cost calculation is original hypothetical additive service work, not measured response-time improvement.

example_limits: New canonical batching article. Established general technique verified with four official references, distinct from preserved specialized data-microbatch-processing and ml-batch-serving IDs. Single primary home Performance and Scalability as fifth member. Original telemetry scenario and single-caller Python3 batch-formation model: immutable nonempty byte strings, supplied nondecreasing nonnegative integer simulated milliseconds, positive integer limits3items/6payloadbytes/10ms oldest age. Inputs a@0,bb@4,c@8 emit count@8/4bytes; dddd@12 plus would-be eee@13 exceeds6 so dddd emits size@13/4bytes before eee is admitted; advance23 emits eee age@23/3bytes; f@24,g@25 close26 emits close@26/2bytes. Outputs hand immutable tuples to caller, not actual sends/acks. Age checked before new admission, equality emits prior group, count wins simultaneous count/byte equality; invalid payload rejected before clock/buffer mutation. Empty groups not emitted; oversized payload rejected. No network, real timer, concurrency, durability, retry, transaction or completion tracker. Pending bounds exclude envelope framing, emitted snapshots and demo accumulation. Hypothetical additive service model5ms fixed call+1ms/item:7individual calls42ms versus4batches sizes3/1/1/2 costing8/6/6/7ms total27ms, saving15ms of service work only, excluding collection/queueing/overlap/real destination costs. DynamoDB partial-outcome context is separate from collector execution. All scenarios, program, cost assumptions and diagrams are teaching material.
